foundation-sec-8b.notes: Cisco Foundation AI base model (Llama 3.1 8B). Use plain MCQ completion prompt.

lily-cyber-7b.notes: Mistral-7B instruct fine-tuned on cybersecurity QA.

baronllm-v2.notes: GGUF-only (~16GB). Requires a running OpenAI-compatible server at --api-base-url. Not usable without vLLM/Ollama/llama.cpp server.

trendyol-cyber-70b.notes: GGUF-only (~40GB+). Requires a running OpenAI-compatible server at --api-base-url. Too large for typical home-cache HF download.

cybertuned.notes: BERT-style encoder (not generative). Ranks MCQ options by masked-LM score; not comparable to generative LLM accuracy.
